_comment: SB3 profile: Air role on the RSP1B (SDRplayV3 serial 2405265A60) instead of the RTL NESDR SMArTee 95339533 — the 2026-07-21 Air->RSP1B trial. Channels, center, mount, and audio tap are IDENTICAL to air-airband-nashville.json so the ONLY variable under test is the device. Kept at 2.048 Msps (not 8) deliberately: the four channels span 118.400-119.450 = +/-525 kHz around center 118.925, which fits inside the +/-1.024 MHz window, and Neptune already runs SDRTrunk P25 on the RSPduo — minimizing the CPU delta protects neptune-trunk.mp3, the non-negotiable. bandwidthIndex 3 (1.536 MHz IF) covers the +/-525 kHz span and mirrors Venus's proven 2 Msps airband RSP recipe. GAIN: SDRplay does not use the RTL's single gain field — ifAGC 0 (fixed, no AGC float) + ifGain -30 (IF gain REDUCTION in negative dB) + lnaIndex 3. audio strategy stays system_default: per the Phase 2 finding, only SDRangel's virtual 'System default device' (idx -1) SUSTAINS the copyToUDP tap; a named/physical device bursts and flaps the mount. THIS PROFILE DOES NOT REPLACE air.airband.nashville — that RTL profile stays on disk untouched so `sb3-ctl profile load air.airband.nashville --execute` is a <60s rollback. Rev 5.2 of the fleet policy permits this: SDRTrunk holds the RSPduo in its own process (per-device Dv00) and SDRangel holds the RSP1B in its process (Dv01) — one RSP per process is the supported pattern.
name: air.airband.nashville.rsp1b
